authored_policy: Facts vocabulary and console/site/source namespaces operationalize responsibility/scope, not a prescribed HSE schema or source authentication. All record/approval claims are fictional.
input_history: Nine original models copied raw: six pairs, one quiet coverage control and two scope controls. Preparation markers inside models remain historical.

observed_private_software_scope.scope: Finite source-informed collection software only; not alarm metrics, installed configuration, operator capacity, human usefulness or company acceptance.

reuse: Only named optional evidence_show_fields are projected. Transcribe permitted references/qualifiers into model facts and retain originals/revisions in the approved company home; no arbitrary journal/document ingestion. Placeholder literals retain their values with blank state.
public_expected_phase: Must be generated by normal CLI in a repository-shaped view with current default catalog/public paths; no private output relabeling or invented after hashes.
